result.title: Exact Risk Certificates for Pairwise-Judged Reranking
result.summary: Pairwise relevance judgments constrain both the loss numerator and the ideal-ranking denominator of nDCG. We characterize the exact worst-case loss of replacing a ranking with a fixed proposal. Binary gains attain this loss and provide an inspectable witness. Threshold verification reduces to at most $K+1$ maximum-closure problems. Our exposure-flow ablation isolates denominator coupling: on shared judge trajectories, exact verification saves 2.34 comparisons per TREC-DL development query and 1.98 per confirmation query at a budget of 32. Savings transfer to BEIR and a second proposer. Predictive gates achieve higher deployment gains, while certificates expose the worst gains still permitted by accepted comparisons.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究成对相关性判断下重排序的风险认证问题，刻画以固定提案替换原排序时的精确最坏情况 nDCG 损失，并把阈值验证归约为最多 K+1 个最大闭包问题，在限定比较预算下做消融与跨数据集验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「精确最坏情况认证＋预算内阈值验证／比较数节省」的线索可供核查，或可类比 LVR 中 STOP 决策与证据验证成本的核算框架；但该工作不涉及内部状态或视觉推理，迁移仅为推测。
